name: UeMW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The top championship set out in Underground e-Mail Wrestling's own founding handbook; no card was ever posted to crown a first holder.

name: UeMW Hardcore Championship
epitaph: A second championship, contested only under no-disqualification rules, set out in Underground e-Mail Wrestling's own founding handbook; no card was ever posted to crown a first holder.

name: UeMW Lightweight Championship
epitaph: A weight-limited championship set out in Underground e-Mail Wrestling's own founding handbook; no card was ever posted to crown a first holder.
